crons.//: Daily, because Vercel's Hobby plan only permits once-a-day crons — an hourly schedule fails the deployment outright. That costs precision on the RESOLVED rule only: 'delete uploads 24h after completion' becomes 24-48h in practice, since the job can only notice an elapsed window when it runs. The ABANDONED rule does not depend on this schedule at all — startSubmissionAction sweeps unpaid submissions too, so the flow cleans up after itself under any real traffic. Move to '0 * * * *' on Pro.
